stories.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
stories.description: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

stories.title: BBC's Orla Guerin travels with Yemen's southern national security forces through desert battlefield

stories.title: Why is it so hard to fight the Houthis?
stories.description: Security correspondent Frank Gardner explains how the Iran-backed Houthis' precision strikes and guerrilla tactics have made it difficult for Saudi forces to gain the upper hand.
